MEET THE ARTIST / 김사월

Kim Sawol

Kim Sawol is a Korean folk singer-songwriter. She began releasing music with Kim Haewon in 2014 and made her solo debut with Suzanne in 2015. Her songs look closely at love, loneliness and the contradictions of everyday life.

FOLK / 2018

Someone누군가에게

Official music video

View release on Apple Music ↗

“Someone” holds on to affection and doubt at the same time. Written and composed by Kim Sawol, it appears on her second studio album Romance, released in September 2018.

Listening note

The album’s notes describe love as a way of coming to know yourself, even while knowing it will end. “Someone” sits inside that larger story of closeness and solitude.
